## Workflow
- [ ] PR title uses `<TASKID>: <short Linear-aligned description>`.
- [ ] Branch name uses `feat/<taskid>`, `fix/<taskid>`, `chore/<taskid>`, or `epic/<epictaskid>`.
- [ ] All applicable PR template sections are filled.
- [ ] No Linear or GitHub assignees were added unless explicitly requested or required for a manual human action.
- [ ] PR is ready for review unless the human explicitly requested a draft.
